reviewFindings: Separate comparison followed authoring and covered three final sources, all ten packet bindings, three lessons, thirteen keys and thirty-nine wrong-option rationales, three unfamiliar manual cases and six recall-card backs.
Repaired literal question-mark punctuation damage before final comparison; all fifteen official statement strings remain unchanged.
Tightened the ACCESS 2025-2026 new-baseline rule to explicitly prohibit comparisons with previous-year scale scores, without inventing a conversion.
Seven source ids are reused only with exact matching URL and full SHA-256. S1, S9 and S10 receive appended snapshot ids; no earlier snapshot is rewritten.

Preserved twelve exposure families across thirteen decisions; scaffold-up and accommodation deliberately share the earlier scaffold-concept family. Interaction is taught and required in the planning case; one-domain and composite-inflation cautions form one decision.
Every objective retains gaps. No human-review promotion, learner data, automatic case grading, exit cut score, MCAS code table, proprietary SIOP feature list, timeline or effect size was introduced.
